about.title: About Me
about.intro: Armed with a degree in Management Information Systems, I don't just write code—I craft digital experiences. To me, User Experience (UX) is never an afterthought: a web interface must be as intuitive and fluid as it is beautiful.
about.education: Fascinated by Artificial Intelligence, I constantly push the boundaries of this technology. I analyze every new LLM release on the market and take genuine pleasure in demystifying and sharing these breakthroughs with my tech community.
about.passion: But life isn't just about algorithms. I'm a massive anime enthusiast and a die-hard football fan, and I unwind by listening to both French and US rap. Simply put: a passionate developer, but mostly a chill guy always ready for the next challenge.
